latency_definition: Nearest-rank p95; missing or failed measurements sort last. Click is the trusted DOM click event and Platform receipt is the completion of the original Product v1 POST containing the durable receipt. Frame is requestVideoFrameCallback on the exact original preview task, formal Resource, or the visible assistant message whose ID and original command were committed in the pre-submit IndexedDB transaction. Standard estimates are actual editor-triggered product price reads; quote_* records a separate explicit complete consumption preview issued after the original receipt. Studio host traces correlate by HTTP response X-Request-ID, provider is the unique matching call in that host span.

clock_correlation.platform_post: Original Studio command joins the same owner and original operation to platform_operation_requests.purpose=invoke; its request_id matches the Gin ingress trace.
clock_correlation.identity: The Studio POST records the trace header from the official SDK GET /identity for this session; the same Gin trace supplies its HTTP duration.
clock_correlation.status: Every included product status GET contains the exact original business UUID in its path.
clock_correlation.frame: The assistant message and business UUID are taken from the completed pre-send IndexedDB transaction. Chromium records its presented frame, positive clipping by viewport and scroll ancestors, and CSS visibility. The first decoded frame is preserved separately.
